federal_grants.title: Grants.gov (Federal grant opportunities search)
federal_grants.description: Official entry point for federal grant opportunities. Use the search tool to find open and forecasted opportunities by keyword, agency, and eligibility.

foundation_grants.title: Candid (Find funders and grantmakers)
foundation_grants.description: Directory-style resource to identify foundations and grantmakers. Use as a reliable starting point to locate non-federal funding sources.

disability_assistance.title: Benefits.gov (Find government benefit programs)
disability_assistance.description: Search for benefits and assistance programs that may apply, including state-specific and local programs. Useful when eligibility is complex or profile data is incomplete.
